title: Publishing record identity
description: Canonical identity of one publishing record in the Active Inference Institute estate. The journal's metadata.json is the record; item, video_id and session ids are the join keys every other repository uses. Machine-readable rules are under x-identity, which scripts/gate/identity.py enforces, so this file is the only copy of the grammar.

series.description: Name of a directory above the item directory inside the corpus.

item.description: Item directory name; the record's item id.

source.description: Producer family of the content, e.g. youtube.

channel.description: Channel or collection the source belongs to.

category.description: Top-level category used by the human index.

episode.description: Episode ordinal within the series, as text.

duplicate_of.description: Record path of the canonical item this one duplicates, with the leading data/<type>/<source>/ removed.

doi.description: Paper DOI when the record is tied to a publication.

parts.description: Video parts of the record; each part is one video id.

identity_free_artifacts.captions/: Filenames are verbatim source names (measured 2026-11-12: 421 of 624 begin youtube_captions, the rest are human titles). Never derive a record id from them.
identity_free_artifacts.translations/: Filenames carry an id prefix for most files but not all (measured: 249 distinct prefixes, several are titles). Resolve the record through metadata.json first.
identity_free_artifacts.assets/: Curated content, organised by type. Carries no identity.

x-identity.join_rule: Consumers join on video (video_id), documents on paper (doi), publications on pub (doi + version). An item id is only meaningful inside this corpus and must be paired with its path.
